candidatePolicy: Pin exact final runtime source before executing. Historical b002 and 9a1d observations retain original source; never relabel.

population.unit: actual adopted video + stable source unit/fragment + operator implementation + semantic target + applicable time range and parameters
population.method: Replay every adopted output Native clock with telemetry preserving arguments and returns. Require all adopted Native RGBA hashes, source/shipped tree, input, plan, renderer, output profile and selection identity correspondence.
conservativeRules: Executed decoration remains important unless pre-existing independent semantic evidence establishes it is only ancillary; no size-based post-hoc exclusion.
Identical runtime function objects are aliases of implementation only; distinct parameters/targets/instances retain separate intent IDs.
TREAT:none is an explicit identity operation, not an independent effect.
Manual locks remain protected but are separate from natural selection improvement.
Local HOLD:still or CAMERA:stillCamera remains a stillness intent, not proof that composite result is static.
Selected settings without dispatch remain UNMEASURED; missing dispatch alone does not prove non-execution because closures can retain references.
Composite hook execution never certifies individual constituent effects.

controls.original: Existing complete adopted MP4 reused by exact hash, not re-encoded and renamed ORIGINAL.
controls.isolation: Disable only named executable operator. Preserve plan, seed, profile, input audio/images/lyrics, other operator behavior and immutable original renderer-cache measurements. Registry entry controls affect only one named entry, not all aliases.
controls.native: Require original full-output Native hashes equal reproduced ON and ON_REPEAT. Preserve mismatch as STALE/UNVERIFIED. Original measured cache restoration must be explicit, hash-bound and reported.
controls.encoding: All 3 additional MP4s complete, H.264/AAC, ffprobe, full FFmpeg decode, videoSHA256, requested and actual decoded timestamp retained.
controls.durability: Save each completed Blob to disk immediately, before assertions or subsequent controls. A later failure does not destroy earlier complete movies.
controls.meaning: Global RMS/screen change establishes only encoded contribution. VERIFIED semantic intent requires target-specific measured direction, displacement/distance/visible area/time/speed decay/static persistence/event peak/transition structure with independent isolation and existing criteria.
controls.reuse: One representative control certifies another selected instance only with explicit same implementation/applicability and per-instance actual decoded pixel correspondence. Otherwise other instance stays UNMEASURED.

existingCriteriaUnchanged.contributionNoiseFloor: greater than max(1 luma, 3 times repeat noise)
existingCriteriaUnchanged.source: Existing semantic travel and independently preregistered crop controls; not newly fitted to results.

gateIntegration: Populate expectedImportantIntentIds from actual final-candidate classified dispatch. Existing dev/release_gates.cjs is unchanged. Every required important intent must have exactly one verified, isolated encoded raw measurement. Empty population cannot PASS.
limits: Machine operator realization is not artistic 100-point certification.
Historical 188/188 registered points apply to the one measured continuity path only.
The 170 registered/selected setting records are not 170 independently realized effects.
